success.name: 4850真实2040回初流血剩余回合红增15%封顶90%，固粉真不增
success.assertion: const base=make({move:10001,index:-1});turn(base);const red=sum(base);for(const n of[0,1,6,9]){const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true});if(n)s.fighters[0].ailments['流血']=n;const other=[];observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)for(const type of['fixed','percent','true'])other.push(c.hurt(c.t,100,'测试非红',type));},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.pharaoh2040.bonus,Math.min(90,n*15));assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-red*(1+Math.min(90,n*15)/100))<=2);assert.deepEqual(other,[100,100,100]);}

 const b=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),true);},()=>turn(b));assert.ok(b.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']);
